descriptions.text: Mana Toast. This is toast. It refills your mana. That’s it. Nothing more. Fuck you.

beats.headline: One per crawler
beats.text: An unmanned safe room was once an industrial kitchen, stripped of everything but a working walk-in freezer. On a steel counter under the screens sits a plain metal toaster in a pile of crumbs, plugged into nothing and impossible to lift. The screen reads Free Mana Toast! One per Crawler! Carl presses the handle and a burned triangle of toast jumps out onto the counter. Its description ends with fuck you. Well, that was unnecessary, he mutters, and gives his piece to Donut, who tucks both away.

beats.headline: Held in reserve
beats.text: Outside the kobold boss room, Donut has a pool of twenty-eight mana points, two pieces of mana toast and a pile of mana restoration potions. With her two-minute cooldown between potions, the potions are next to useless in a battle. So they decide to wait and see what they face first.

beats.headline: Not a potion
beats.text: Planting barrel bombs from alley to alley, Carl and Donut chain invisibility potions. Donut's potion countdown is much better than it used to be, but at a minute forty-five it still means she cannot keep her mana topped off and stay invisible. She has two slices of mana toast saved for an emergency. The toast would top off her spell points and would not count as a potion, and Carl does not want her using it unless it is absolutely necessary.
